facts.summary: Phase 2 adult CAH trial missed primary endpoint, trial terminated, 21% layoffs · Phase 2 · tildacerfont in classic CAH · not yet approved

evidence.summary: CAHmelia-203 Study of Tildacerfont in Adult Classic Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) with Severe Hyperandrogenemia Did Not Meet Primary Efficacy Endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The clinical trial did not achieve the primary efficacy endpoint of the assessment of dose-response for the change in A4 from baseline to week 12.
evidence.safety: Tildacerfont was generally safe and well tolerated at all doses, with no treatment-related serious adverse events (SAEs).
